about: The offertorium of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass I” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Lord Jesus Christ, King of glory, set free the souls of all the faithful departed from the punishments of hell and from the deep pit; set them free from the mouth of the lion, that the abyss may not swallow them up, that they may not fall into darkness; but may the holy standard-bearer Michael bring them into the holy light: Which You promised long ago to Abraham and to his seed. Sacrificial gifts and prayers of praise we offer to You, O Lord: do You receive them on behalf of those souls whom we commemorate today; make them, O Lord, pass over from death to life. Which You promised long ago to Abraham and to his seed.
